entities.name: Reconfiguration algorithm for m rhombical meta-modules

claims.subject: Woods et al. (2013) self-assembly
claims.evidence_quote: Woods et al. (2013) showed that in the nubot model, the robots are able to self-assemble arbitrary shapes/patterns in an amount of time equal to the worst-case running time for a Turing machine to compute a pixel in the shape/pattern plus an additional factor which is polylogarithmic in its size.
